description: This is a unit test class for the Utils functions in the SuiteCRM project, using PHPUnit framework. It tests utility functions such as getAppString, encode/decode multienumerations, language settings, user authorization, PHP version checks, byte size conversions, and XSS security filtering.

classes.name: UtilsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing utility functions in SuiteCRM, verifying behavior and correctness of various helper functions.

methods.name: testGetAppString
methods.description: Tests retrieval of application strings with existing, non-existing, and empty label handling.

methods.name: testencodeMultienumValue
methods.description: Verifies encoding of multienumeration arrays to string representations.

methods.name: testunencodeMultienum
methods.description: Verifies decoding of multienum strings back to arrays.

methods.name: testget_languages
methods.description: Checks retrieval of languages and their display names.

methods.name: testget_current_language
methods.description: Tests the logic of fetching current user language with session and default config fallback.

methods.name: testis_admin
methods.description: Verifies admin status check for user objects.

methods.name: testcheck_php_version
methods.description: Tests PHP version comparison logic for different version strings.

methods.name: testreturn_bytes
methods.description: Verifies conversion of string sizes into byte integers.

methods.name: testSecureXSS
methods.description: Ensures that potential XSS strings are sanitized to safe HTML.
